subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should UX-012 remain a separate 2px composer progress bar now that current main has a freshness-aware context usage ring, or should the work fold into that existing context notice?
rationale: Both directions can be implemented, but choosing between a second always-visible meter and the existing ring/popover is a Control UI density and stale-state policy decision rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Fold into the existing context notice
options.body: Refresh the branch around the current context ring and reuse its freshness, cost, warning, and compaction behavior instead of adding a parallel meter.

options.title: Keep a separate thin meter
options.body: Allow the 2px bar as a distinct UX element, but require it to use totalTokensFresh and add stale, zero, overfull, and reduced-motion coverage.

options.title: Pause this UX slice
options.body: Close or pause this PR until the broader token/quota visibility work settles the desired chat surface.

recommendation.title: Fold into the existing context notice
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch around the current context ring and reuse its freshness, cost, warning, and compaction behavior instead of adding a parallel meter.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is both the PR author and the strongest prior Control UI context-usage contributor in the available history.
